name: After § 13
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the budget of the EU joint undertakings for the financial year 2023
part_text: 13 a. Welcomes the work of the European Court of Auditors and regrets that the 2023 discharge on the Joint Undertakings does not provide any added value compared to the annual report on the EU Joint Undertakings for the financial year 2023 prepared by the European Court of Auditors, which questions the role of the Parliament and its own investigative, critical analysis and oversight work;
